submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires retrospectively on words denoting an institutionally or socially assigned standing of a person, object, or quantity: prior or founding role (former, founder, owner), rank (first), quantity (number), exchange value (cost, price), change of state or possession (conversion, transfer), or asserted entitlement (claiming, owning). It peaks on the whole token for single-token words and on the non-initial piece for BPE-split words (K+ering, back+ped+aled, re+interpret); strength grades down to related words (value, worth, delivery, latter, last) and to ~0 on concrete near-neighbors (prize, bill, farmer, lumber, load, count, most). It does not prepare any specific upcoming token: the Jacobian-lens promoted list is incoherent with kurtosis ~3.1 and the tokens after peaks vary freely (MI6 chief, of, code, associated, $7, -rate, proposed).
